findings.title: runBlocking in onCreate blocks the main thread
findings.why: onCreate waits until the session refresh completes, which can freeze the app or trigger an ANR.

findings.title: prefetch() launches in GlobalScope
findings.why: The work is never cancelled and outlives its caller.
findings.fix: Make `prefetch()` a suspend function or take a `CoroutineScope`.

findings.title: `!!` on a session that can be null
findings.why: `current()` returns null when nobody is signed in, so `!!` throws a NullPointerException inside the coroutine.
findings.fix: Return early when there is no session.

findings.title: requireUser() always throws in refresh()
findings.why: This change removes the `warmUp()` call from `init`, and nothing else calls `warmUp()`. `cachedUser` therefore stays null, and `requireUser()` always throws IllegalStateException when `refresh()` runs.

preExisting.title: displayName() asserts a stored name with `!!`
preExisting.why: `displayName()` throws a NullPointerException when no name has been stored, which crashes the app.
preExisting.fix: Return a default name, or make `displayName()` return `String?`.

preExisting.title: warmUp() launches in GlobalScope
preExisting.fix: Launch it in a scope owned by the caller.
